first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify its downstream customer quality and compare it with onboarding evidence before committing, since sustainable qualified revenue—not short-term volume—is the objective.

final.rationale: Run a shortened-onboarding experiment. Its source record confirms higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding decline while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing because its acquisition lift came with a 12% retention decline and failure through the first renewal cycle.
